image_description: A modern indoor staircase featuring a prominent, glossy red handrail system. The handrail is thick and tubular, supported by thin black vertical metal balusters. The stairs are white with a clean, minimalist design. A sign on the left wall reads 'Norton Museum of Art'. The perspective looks up the staircase, showing multiple flights and landings.
